subject: Defense Power-Up trick
text: Tapping the shoot or steal button eight times on the Tonight's Match-Up screen gives a Def. Power-Up signal before tipoff.

evidence.quote: tap the shoot or steal button eight times.
If you do this correctly, there will be a Def. Power-Up signal before tipoff

subject: Def. Power-Up
text: With Def. Power-Up, the player can effectively goaltend every time by standing near the net and jumping as the ball comes near.

evidence.quote: You now can effectively goal-tend everytime by just standing near the net and jumping up as the ball comes near.

subject: Powerup Dunks trick
text: Rotating the joystick 360 degrees on the Tonight's Match-Up screen and then tapping turbo seven times gives Powerup Dunks.

evidence.quote: rotate the joystick or joypad 360 degrees
then tap the turbo button seven times.
be a sign stating that you have Powerup Dunks.

subject: Powerup Dunks
text: The player with Powerup Dunks can do all special dunks, from as far away as half-court.

evidence.quote: The player that you powerup can now do ALL the special dunks, from as far away as half-court.

subject: Powerup Fire trick
text: Powerup Fire is triggered on the Tonight's Match-Up screen by holding up and the shoot button until tipoff.

evidence.quote: then hold up and the shoot button until tipoff.
done correctly, there will be a Powerup Fire sign just before tipoff.

subject: Powerup Fire
object: on fire and unlimited turbo for the whole game
text: Powerup Fire keeps the player on fire for the whole game, with unlimited turbo and goaltending for the whole game.

evidence.quote: will allow the person with Powerup Fire to be on fire for the whole game.
will also have unlimited turbo and can goaltend for the whole game as well.

subject: Shooting Percentage trick
text: Turning on turbo for all three buttons and rotating the joystick 360 degrees clockwise until tipoff shows the Shot % display.

evidence.quote: Before playing selecting your team, turn on turbo for all three of your buttons.
rotate your joystick or joypad 360 degrees clockwise continuously while holding down all three buttons (for turbo) until tipoff.
If done properly, there will be a sign stating "Shot % display activated."

subject: Shot % display
text: The Shot % display shows the probability of a shot going in, from 05% past midcourt up to 99% when on fire, in the lower right corner.

evidence.quote: Now everytime you take a shot (not including dunks or layups) there will be a small square in the lower right-hand corner telling you the probability of your shot going in, from 05% from past midcourt to 99% when on fire.

subject: Shot % display
text: The displayed shot percentage is unreliable: a 05% shot can often go in and 99% shots are often missed.

evidence.quote: However, the % does not really mean much, since you can often make an 05% shot and can miss 99% shots regularly.

subject: Shot % display
object: on fire, distance, defenders, score difference, computer assistance
text: The shot percentage is affected by being on fire, closeness to the basket, defenders in your face, the point difference, and whether computer assistance is turned on or off.

evidence.quote: The shot percentage is affected by being on fire, closeness to the basket, defenders in your face, the difference of points between the two teams, and if computer assistance is turned on or off in the Options screen.
